item.title: Whiskers 0.8.64
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.64

### Free Dictation & Transcription

  • Made Whiskers free to use, including dictation and Audio Transcription, with no cumulative transcription quota or paid feature unlock
  • Added a Whiskers Cloud preview in Settings for optional cloud access planned for the future

    • ### Audio Capture Reliability

  • Improved capture recovery and shutdown handling so recordings are finalized safely when capture is interrupted or Whiskers quits

    • ### Transcript Chat

  • Improved chat for speaker-labeled recordings so speaker names stay readable in responses and copied text

    • ### AI Enhancement

  • Updated the recommended enhancement model to GPT-4.1 Nano for faster, lower-cost transcript cleanup
